annualEvents.name: Grand National Festival
annualEvents.notes: Three-day racing festival at Aintree. One of the world's most famous horse races. Massive tourism draw.

annualEvents.name: Liverpool Sound City
annualEvents.notes: Major music festival and conference across multiple venues in the Baltic Triangle.

annualEvents.name: On The Waterfront
annualEvents.notes: Free outdoor music festival at Pier Head. Major summer event.

annualEvents.name: Africa Oyé
annualEvents.notes: UK's largest free celebration of African music and culture in Sefton Park.

annualEvents.name: Liverpool International Music Festival
annualEvents.notes: Major music festival celebrating Liverpool's musical heritage.

annualEvents.name: River of Light
annualEvents.notes: Illuminated art trail along Liverpool waterfront. Massive family attraction.

annualEvents.name: Liverpool Christmas Market
annualEvents.notes: Major Christmas market running mid-November through Christmas at St George's Plateau.

annualEvents.name: Comic Con Liverpool
annualEvents.notes: Large comic and pop culture convention at ACC Liverpool.

annualEvents.name: Rock 'n' Roll Marathon
annualEvents.notes: Major running event through Liverpool city centre.

annualEvents.name: Mathew Street Festival
annualEvents.notes: Huge Beatles-themed music festival. One of Liverpool's biggest annual events.

annualEvents.name: LightNight Liverpool
annualEvents.notes: Late night arts and culture festival across city centre venues.

annualEvents.name: Brouhaha International Festival
annualEvents.notes: International street arts and carnival festival.

annualEvents.name: Liverpool Pride
annualEvents.notes: Major LGBTQ+ pride event at Pier Head.

annualEvents.name: Giants Spectacular
annualEvents.notes: Royal de Luxe giants parade through Liverpool. Not annual but recurring. Massive city impact when it happens.
